healingAttempts.resolution: Abandoned; switched to direct blob upload + OneDeploy REST call

healingAttempts.issue: az functionapp deploy --type zip returned 415 Unsupported Media Type
healingAttempts.resolution: Called SCM /api/publish directly with Content-Type: application/zip + AAD Bearer

healingAttempts.issue: OneDeploy 202 succeeded but /api/health returned 404 and no functions registered
healingAttempts.resolution: Inspected zip; @scrapbook/shared was empty (npm created a Windows junction which Compress-Archive does not follow). Rewrote build-api.ps1 to npm pack shared and install from tarball so real files ship. Re-deployed as 3672a9ef-0a38-4c64-b88e-78033af3d3a1; 14 functions registered; health 200 OK.

healingAttempts.issue: Initial post-deploy lockdown set main site to Deny-all, blocking SWA -> API traffic (403).
healingAttempts.resolution: Restored main site defaultAction to Allow (public) and kept scm defaultAction Deny; verified /api/health 200 from external client.
